name: video-device-footage
description: Found-footage clips that pass as a real device recording: one 4-12 s vertical 9:16 clip with native audio, written as one fictional, device-locked paragraph by one of seven writers (police or firefighter bodycam, courtroom security camera, security camera, video doorbell, phone bystander, hydraulic press, nature or process b-roll), then one text-to-video call, a read-back and a whole-clip contact-sheet check. Use when: a bodycam, CCTV, security-cam, doorbell-cam, courtroom-cam, caught-on-a-phone, press-crush or found-footage b-roll clip is asked for, or a short that must look caught on camera rather than filmed. NOT for: GTA-style game-capture clips (not offered); a stitched story, montage, captions, logo or voiceover (edit-beat-montage, edit-captions, media-video-production); a free-prompt text or image to video clip (media-video-generation); a script (media-script-writer); a sound bed alone (media-audio-generation); running ai-gen in general (media-ai-gen); measuring files (media-qc).
